content: Route handlers testable two ways: (a) direct invocation — construct Request/NextRequest, call exported GET/POST, assert Response.status/json (fast, needs vi.mock for next/headers/cookies if handler uses them); (b) next-test-api-route-handler (NTARH) — emulates real Next request pipeline with real cookies()/headers()/params context, MUST be first import in the test file; pass appHandler module + params, assert via provided fetch; supports requestPatcher/responsePatcher. Server actions tested as plain async functions — mock next/headers + next/navigation (redirect throws NEXT_REDIRECT), next/cache revalidatePath, and the session helper to return desired user. react cache() and AsyncLocalStorage make unmocked next/headers throw at import — pre-mock in vitest.setup.ts. happy-dom environment.
